items.docs: Returns the site's 35 published posts — 26 in the "Press Release" category, 8 in "Publication", 1 uncategorised — spanning 2021-08-12 to 2025-12-08. Each item carries a full `content.rendered` body. Paginated; totals are returned in the X-WP-Total and X-WP-TotalPages response headers.
